sources.title: Pudacuo National Park in Shangri-La Yunnan - ChinaXianTour
sources.content:
Pudacuo National Park - Complete Information

Overview
Pudacuo National Park, also called Potatso National Park, is located in Shangri-La County, Yunnan. It earned recognition as "China's first national park to meet the standards of the International Union for Conservation of Nature" and became a UNESCO World Heritage site. The park encompasses over 500 square miles with diverse alpine ecosystems.

Key Geographic Details
- Location: 13.6 miles east of downtown Shangri-La
- Altitude: 11,483-13,645 feet
- Area: Over 1,300 square kilometers

Major Attractions

Bita Lake: Known for its "gorgeous emerald waters," this glacial lake is surrounded by ancient pines, cypress trees, and snow-capped peaks. The lake features prayer flags and a small island frequented by various bird species. A 2.6-mile wooden boardwalk circles the lake, or visitors can take boat rides (CNY 50).

Shudu Lake: The park's core scenic area surrounded by forests and wildlife including musk deer, bears, leopards, and golden cats. This 2-mile lakeside trail is accessible via hiking, biking (CNY 70-90), or boat (CNY 50).

Militang Pasture: The largest grassland, meaning "Buddha's eye" in Tibetan. Features wetlands, brooks, grazing yaks and sheep, mushrooms, and wildflowers.

Ecology & Wildlife
The park protects rare and endangered species: "leopards, cranes, macaques, and lynxes." It contains ancient fir forests and the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey.

Visitor Information
Tickets: CNY 138 total (CNY 68 park entrance + CNY 70 sightseeing bus)
Additional Activities: Boat rides CNY 50-70; Bicycle rentals CNY 70-90
Operating Hours: April-October 7:30 AM-4:00 PM; November-March 8:30 AM-4:00 PM
Recommended Visit Duration: One day

Transportation
- From Diqing Shangri-La Airport: 40-50 minutes by taxi
- From Shangri-La town: Daily coaches available (CNY 15) from Shangri-La Coach Station
- Park-operated sightseeing buses transport visitors between attractions

Best Time to Visit
"April to October" offers optimal weather. Spring showcases blooming flowers, while winter creates a snow-covered landscape.

Nearby Attractions
- Songzanlin Monastery
- Dukezong Ancient Town

sources.title: Pudacuo National Park: Shudu Lake, Bita Lake & Militang Pasture - China Discovery
sources.content:
Pudacuo National Park: Shudu Lake, Bita Lake & Militang Pasture

Pudacuo National Park is notable as the first national park in China to meet International Union for Conservation of Nature standards. It consists of three main parts: Shudu Lake, Bita Lake and Militang Grassland with minority villages, lush forests, emerald lakes and gorgeous pasture views.

The park is situated in the east of Shangri-La, about 23km from Shangri-La City, taking half an hour or so by car. Admission Fee is 258 yuan (note: prices may have changed).

Best time to visit is from May to October. During these months, the weather is mild, and the park is lush and vibrant. Spring brings blooming flowers, while autumn offers golden landscapes.

The park protects one of the most biodiverse alpine ecosystems in China, including rare species like the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey.

sources.title: Pudacuo, China National Park Guide (2026) - Trails & Tips
sources.content:
Pudacuo National Park Guide 2026 - Trails & Tips

Pudacuo National Park is China's first national park meeting IUCN standards, located about 22 km east of Shangri-La city. The park sits at an altitude of 3,500 to 4,159 meters.

The park features two main lakes (Shudu Lake and Bita Lake) connected by the Militang alpine meadow. Sightseeing buses transport visitors between the main areas, with wooden boardwalk trails at each stop.

You should wear warm clothes when traveling to Pudacuo National Park during winter seasons, and please check weather forecast of Shangri-La and prepare warm clothes no matter which season you come.

Take the bus from Shangri-la Bus Station to Potatso; the bus departs at 09:30 and returns at 15:00; ticket fare is CNY 30 for a round-trip.

For travelers who want to visit Shudu Lake and Bita Lake by boat, you should pay extra 50 Yuan for each lake.

sources.title: Pudacuo National Park, Shangri-la: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Pudacuo National Park, Shangri-la: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026

Pudacuo National Park is China's first national park to meet international conservation standards. Located about 22 km east of Shangri-La, the park encompasses pristine alpine lakes, meadows, and forests at elevations between 3,500 and 4,159 meters.

The park consists of three main areas: Shudu Lake, Bita Lake, and Militang Pasture. Visitors move between areas via park shuttle buses included in the ticket price.

Best time to visit is May through October for mild weather and lush scenery. The park is open year-round but winter brings cold temperatures and snow.

Altitude considerations: The park sits above 3,500 meters, so visitors should be aware of potential altitude effects. Move slowly and stay hydrated.

sources.title: 普达措国家公园 - 百度百科
sources.content:
普达措国家公园 - 完整文本内容

基本信息
普达措国家公园位于云南省迪庆藏族自治州香格里拉市建塘镇红坡村，处于滇西北"三江并流"世界自然遗产中心地带，距香格里拉城区22千米。总面积约1313平方千米，是中国大陆第一个被定名为国家公园的保护区。
外文名：Potatso National Park
景点级别：AAAAA级
开放时间：08:00-16:00

地理环境
公园由碧塔海自然保护区和属都湖景区两部分构成，以碧塔海、属都湖和弥里塘亚高山牧场为主要组成部分。"范围内最高点海拔4670米，最低点海拔2347米"。

气候特点
属亚温带和寒温带季风气候，雨量充沛。年平均气温5.4℃，最热月份（7月）月均气温13.2℃，最冷月（1月）月均气温-3.8℃。

自然资源
植物资源：园内有种子植物140科568属2275种，其中国家一级保护植物5种。
动物资源：记录兽类8目23科74种，鸟类19目58科297种。一级保护动物8种（豹、林麝、马麝、黑颈鹤、绿尾红雉、斑尾榛鸡、雉鹑、胡兀鹫）。

主要景点
属都湖："属都"在藏语中意为"奶酪如同石头一样结实"。湖中盛产"属都裂腹鱼"，鱼身金黄，腹部有一条裂纹。景区路线包括南岸木栈道3.3千米、沿河生态徒步2.2千米、北岸藏族原始游牧部落文化体验线路3千米。

碧塔海：省级自然保护区、国际重要的高原淡水湖泊湿地。"碧塔"在藏语中为"栎树成毡"之意。步行栈道约4.4千米。

弥里塘亚高山牧场：公园最大的草甸区域。

神话传说
相传天女梳妆时不小心失落的镜子破碎形成了许多高原湖泊，碧塔海就是其中镶有绿宝石的最美镜片。

旅游信息
总票价：138元/人次（游览车费70元+门票费68元）
交通信息：香格里拉客运站有班车往返；独克宗古城迪庆旅游游客服务中心有班车往返。

开发建设
2006年通过地方立法成立；2007年6月21日正式揭牌；2012年获国家AAAAA级旅游景区。

sources.title: Shangri-La Travel: A Journey to Paradise at Pudacuo National Park
sources.content:
Shangri-La Travel: A Journey to Paradise at Pudacuo National Park

Pudacuo National Park in Shangri-La is a breathtaking alpine wilderness that lives up to the mythical paradise its name evokes. The park features pristine lakes, ancient forests, and alpine meadows at elevations above 3,500 meters.

The park is divided into three main scenic areas connected by shuttle buses. Each area has wooden boardwalk trails that make the terrain accessible while protecting the fragile alpine ecosystem.

The wildlife diversity is remarkable, with the park serving as a sanctuary for numerous endangered species. The lakes are crystal clear, reflecting the surrounding mountains and forests.

Visitors should come prepared for cold weather even in summer, as temperatures can drop significantly at altitude. Warm layers, sun protection, and plenty of water are essential.
